mechanism.claim: The sign of BTC's response to a robust completed global-dollar factor is regime-dependent. At each high-variation weekday close, the signed mean of only the latest already-completed dollar-factor responses identifies whether direct or inverse transmission currently dominates; apply that causal orientation to the current factor for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: factor sign multiplied by sign of the latest-32 mean of factor-sign times mature twelve-hour BTC response
mechanism.why_distinct: DFSR fixes inverse transmission and applies a factor-tail gate. HVCRMR stores responses to BTC price shocks. HVDOER selects among raw-price experts at 03:00. HVDFRM uses every high-variation full-session external dollar factor, one fixed response law, no factor tail, no expert pool, and no future-stage fit.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: pre-decision BTC 24-hour realized-variation rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: weekday 21:05 UTC external-factor response-memory clocks are absent from Gross9

features.factor_source: hash-bound six-pair DFSR source-only full-session dollar factors; no DFSR event clock or side reused
features.factor: strict nonzero median standardized canonical-dollar factor
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed hourly BTC returns over prior 24h)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid weekday decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.mature_response: factor sign at prior eligible decision times log(BTC open at entry+12h / BTC open at entry); label enters memory only after exit open
features.response_memory: arithmetic mean of latest at most 32 mature eligible responses, minimum 20, current and unmatured excluded, strict nonzero

causal_label_authorization.allowed_before_incidence: only prior eligible response labels whose twelve-hour exit open is at or before current decision

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed except causally mature response-label opens until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no factor, memory, label, variation, side, clock, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
